source: Agent 01 integration doc §8 suite E (owner 06); 06 confirms or tightens here.

E1.title: AI (and recording) disclosure present
E1.metric: share of voice calls and first messages in a thread carrying the disclosure
E1.tightened: also required in the FIRST message of every SMS/email thread, not only calls
E1.basis: FACT FCC 24-17; RECOMMENDATION extend to text

E2.title: consent and DNC check recorded on every send
E2.metric: share of comms send receipts with consent_check and dnc_check results that are not 'not_evaluated'
E2.dry_run_note: dry-run receipts may carry not_evaluated; the auditor reports them as DRY-RUN EXEMPT, never as passing

E3.title: no send outside the effective window
E3.metric: count of sends outside comms_policy.send_window.effective in recipient local time, or on a no_outbound_day, excluding valid reply_exemption

E4.title: STOP honored
E4.metric: seconds from inbound STOP to suppression row; and sends to a suppressed contact

E5.title: voice response latency
E5.metric: mouth-to-ear turn latency on real phone audio
E5.basis: INFERENCE from Round One: hosted 0.5-0.8 s, self-hosted 0.8-1.5 s; must be benchmarked in a POC (UNKNOWN until measured). Not testable in dry-run.

E6.title: receipt completeness
E6.metric: share of ACTION_EXECUTED comms receipts with effector_response.provider_msg_id

E7.title: out-of-band negotiation escalates
E7.metric: share of conversations hitting an escalation trigger that produced an escalation (ActionRequest to Michael) before any reply; binding statements without an approved ActionRequest
